description: Free times for a business, from its own booking engine. Answers one of three ways: 'slots' (real free times), 'windows' (the hours the business is open, for a business with no diary of people; NOT free times, the owner confirms the visit time) or 'request' (the business confirms every request itself). Never invents a time. At most 14 days.

from.description: First date, YYYY-MM-DD. Optional, defaults to today.

service_id.description: A service id from get_business_profile. Optional.

to.description: Last date, YYYY-MM-DD. Optional, defaults to a week on.

name: get_availability
title: Get free times
